question:
Select the most appropriate options to fill in the blanks.

L.V.D.T. shows ____ hysteresis and hence repeatability is ____ under all conditions.
solution:
The correct answer is __low; excellent**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• L.V.D.T. (Linear Variable Differential Transformer)__ is a type of electromechanical transducer.
 
• It converts linear displacement into an electrical signal.
 
• Due to its low hysteresis, it provides excellent repeatability under various conditions.
 
• The performance remains consistent over time, making it highly reliable for measurement applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Advantages of L.V.D.T.:**
 
 
• High sensitivity and linearity.
 
• Wide range of measurement.
 
• Robust and durable construction.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used in industries for precise position measurement.
 
• Commonly implemented in automatic control systems.
 
• Effective for monitoring mechanical vibrations and displacements.
